blocks.text: Language and Intercultural Relations Core Elective Table II
For students admitted Fall 2025 and before

links.text: For students admitted Fall 2025 and before

blocks.text: Students must declare their stream upon admission: either French or Spanish.
Students will complete a minimum of 8 Table II courses from their chosen stream.
FRE 302 French Food, Wine and Hospitality
FRE 501 Speaking and Writing French I
FRE 601 Speaking and Writing French II
FRE 603 Enlightenment to La Belle Époque
FRE 706 The Life and Times of the French Language
SPN 302 Spanish for the Tourism Industry
SPN 504 Spanish Language and Culture through Films
SPN 704 Latin American Arts and Culture
SPN 705 The Boom in Latin American Culture
SPN 710 History of the Spanish Language
SPN 804 Culture and Resistance in the Americas
For students admitted Fall 2026 and after

links.text: For students admitted Fall 2026 and after

blocks.text: Students must declare their stream by the start of their second year: French, Spanish or Speech Science. Students in the French and Spanish streams will complete a minimum of 8 Table II courses from their chosen stream. Students in the Speech Science stream will complete a minimum of 13 Table II courses from their chosen stream. Students who choose to complete the minimum number of courses for their stream can choose courses from any other stream to complete their Table II requirements.
REQUIRED GROUP 1: A minimum of two (2) of the following:
Group 2: A minimum of six (6) and a maximum of eleven (11) of the following courses:
FRE 302 French Food, Wine and Hospitality
FRE 501 Speaking and Writing French I
FRE 601 Speaking and Writing French II
FRE 603 Enlightenment to La Belle Époque
FRE 706 The Life and Times of the French Language
REQUIRED GROUP 1: A minimum of two (2) of the following:
SPN 504 Spanish Language and Culture through Films
SPN 704 Latin American Arts and Culture
Group 2: A minimum of six (6) and a maximum of eleven (11) of the following courses:
SPN 302 Spanish for the Tourism Industry
SPN 504 Spanish Language and Culture through Films
SPN 704 Latin American Arts and Culture
SPN 705 The Boom in Latin American Culture
SPN 710 History of the Spanish Language
SPN 804 Culture and Resistance in the Americas
REQUIRED GROUP 1 : Four (4) of the following, with at least three (3) of the same course code:
ASL An American Sign Language course
Group 2: A minimum of two (2) of the following courses:
LIR 207 Translation as a Cultural Bridge
† An online placement test is required. See Department of Languages, Literatures and Cultures' website for details.
